name: Mining and petroleum titles and approvals
what: Obtain exploration and production titles, project and environmental approvals, native title agreements and pay royalties; offshore petroleum is regulated by the Commonwealth.

layers.who: State mines, planning and environment agencies
Commonwealth environment department and offshore petroleum regulators

basis.quote: State and territory governments manage the licences and permits for the mining industry.
Indigenous Land Use Agreements may need to be made with Aboriginal landowners

issues.what: A single mine can hold hundreds of environmental licences, permits and consents from several agencies and tiers.

evidence.source: Annual Review of Regulatory Burdens on Business: Primary Sector
evidence.quote: Cadia estimates that its operations are subject to some 700 licences, permits and consents imposing environmental requirements relating to emissions, waste, noise, dust, flora, fauna, site rehabilitation etc.

issues.status_note: Case study reported in 2007; not rechecked.

issues.what: Offshore petroleum operators submitted the same safety and environmental information to different agencies under separate management plans.

evidence.source: Annual Review of Regulatory Burdens on Business: Primary Sector
evidence.quote: Many of the regulations necessitate submission of the same information - for example, about safety and environmental considerations - at different times and to different agencies.

issues.status_note: Reported in 2007 and not rechecked; it may since have been partly addressed.
